title: Back in a 60 series - 1HZ Swap
transmission: H55F (retained from gas donor); still evaluating 1HDT/H55, 1HZ/H55, or Isuzu 4BD/H55 combinations
ai_summary: Build thread for a 1987 FJ60 (already lifted, on 33-inch tires, ARB bumper, roof rack) planning a diesel swap; early posts show the builder still weighing 1HDT/H55, 1HZ/H55, and Isuzu 4BD/H55 combinations rather than a confirmed completed 1HZ install. Toyota diesel engines quoted at $6k+, offset partly by reselling the original H55F/splitcase; forum consensus favored an H55F input-shaft swap as the path for 1HZ compatibility.

complications.detail: H55F input shaft swap required for 1HZ compatibility, described by an experienced builder as the trickiest part of the job
Cost-benefit debate: $6-7k diesel engine cost weighed against resale value versus a non-restoration build
